text:
ria: Quick follow-up: we need to lock down owners + done criteria for the streaming/chat reliability fixes (timeouts, partials, reconnects). Ill track here.

omar: I'll own reconnect/backoff changes in server + SDK. Acceptance: SDK rate-limit default 1/min, server honors Retry-After and exposes reconnect_hint. PR by 2027-05-08.

jules: I'll take partial-detection and close codes. Plan: detect truncated frames, emit streaming.partial_detected, close code 433. Add e2e that injects truncated frame. ETA 2027-05-12.

ria: Observability to ship: prefix trace propagation, ttfb histogram, sampled payloads w/ PII redaction (7d). Who owns?

omar: I'll add basic metrics and headers. Jules will add the partial metric.

infra-bot: note: pattern observed: downscale windows correlate with partial spikes. Infra will provision 3 warm workers for the canary window.

ria: Canary: ops to run 48h job that includes reconnect floods and cold-starts. Ops, schedule after staging merges.

ops-bot: scheduled "stability-remediate-canary" for staging 2027-05-15 02:00 UTC for 48h. Reports -> #eng-sre.

omar: CI gate: PRs must include a micro-benchmark showing median TTFB regression <= 8%. I'll add a lightweight PR job.

jules: Also adding protocol docs for new close codes and runbook triage steps.

ria: Great. Owners/dates recap: omar PR 2027-05-08, jules PR 2027-05-12, infra warm pool 2027-05-10, canary 2027-05-15. I'll keep this thread as the tracker and post PR links. Next sync Fri 10am PT. :white_check_mark:
